fixture_disclaimer: Synthetic hard-query fixtures are evaluation pressure only. They are not evidence. They are not reviewed records. They do not promote corpus truth.

queries.intent_summary: Find compatible software artifacts or a scoped need for Windows 7-era use.
queries.smallest_useful_unit: reviewed or candidate software artifact, direct member, or scoped compatibility need
queries.minimum_useful_public_output: status, platform scope, candidate or need label, uncertainty, and read-only actions
queries.expected_evidence_shape: compatibility hint, source observation, member path, or explicit source gap
known_ambiguities: apps may mean utilities, games, runtimes, drivers, or support tools
Windows 7 compatibility may require version and architecture details
near_miss_rules: broad operating-system media alone is near_miss at best
generic app collections without member-level clues are near_miss or need
absence_rules: absence must name the checked scope and must not claim exhaustive web search
policy_block_rules: download, install, extraction, and live fanout are blocked in public eval output
queries.notes: A useful result should not be a vague parent collection only.

queries.intent_summary: Find a device-specific Windows 98 driver candidate or request missing hardware identifiers.
queries.smallest_useful_unit: hardware-specific driver candidate or hardware identification need
queries.minimum_useful_public_output: status, missing hardware field, source scope, and safe next action
queries.expected_evidence_shape: device model/vendor evidence, OS compatibility clue, or explicit need for model/vendor
known_ambiguities: Win98 may mean first or second edition
near_miss_rules: driver for a different Windows generation is near_miss
support media without driver member details is near_miss or need
absence_rules: do not claim absence without a declared device and checked scope
policy_block_rules: public output must not expose download, install, or extraction controls
queries.notes: The safest useful unit is often a SearchNeed until hardware identity is known.

queries.query_text: old blue FTP client for XP
queries.intent_summary: Resolve a vague remembered Windows XP FTP-client identity without overstating a visual clue.
queries.smallest_useful_unit: candidate application/version family, near miss, or need for discriminating clues
queries.minimum_useful_public_output: status, vague clue handling, candidate or need label, and uncertainty
queries.expected_evidence_shape: name/version/platform clue plus visual or source observation, or explicit identity gap
known_ambiguities: blue may refer to icon, UI, logo, or memory artifact
FTP client identity may require screenshots or period mentions
near_miss_rules: a plausible XP FTP client without blue evidence is near_miss
a blue app without FTP evidence is near_miss
absence_rules: absence must preserve the vague-memory limitation
policy_block_rules: public output must not expose download, install, crawl, or review controls
queries.notes: A useful eval result may be near_miss if uncertainty is explicit.

queries.intent_summary: Find a manual/document artifact or exact hardware-page candidate for CT1740.
queries.smallest_useful_unit: manual/document artifact, exact hardware-page candidate, or scoped documentation need
queries.minimum_useful_public_output: status, model identifier, document type, source scope, and uncertainty
queries.expected_evidence_shape: model identifier CT1740, document source observation, or manual/source gap
known_ambiguities: related Sound Blaster models may share documentation
manual may be inside a broader scan
near_miss_rules: related model manuals are near_miss unless CT1740 relation is explicit
absence_rules: absence must name searched document/source scope
policy_block_rules: public output must not expose file fetching or extraction controls
queries.notes: Related model material must be labelled near_miss unless CT1740 evidence is clear.

queries.query_text: latest Firefox before XP support ended
queries.intent_summary: Represent version/support-window semantics without substituting modern Firefox.
queries.smallest_useful_unit: candidate or reviewed version answer with compatibility evidence, or a need for support-window evidence
queries.minimum_useful_public_output: status, version/support-window uncertainty, blocked/degraded reason if present, and safe actions
queries.expected_evidence_shape: version, date, support note source, or explicit need for version/support evidence
known_ambiguities: support ended may mean release date or update support cutoff
absence_rules: absence must not imply global release-history search
policy_block_rules: public output must not offer unsupported installs or source fanout
queries.notes: Fixture policy_blocked state demonstrates honest public block rendering, not factual resolution.

queries.query_text: article about ray tracing in a 1994 magazine
queries.intent_summary: Find or scope a periodical article/issue/page request without pretending broad collections are enough.
queries.smallest_useful_unit: article/issue/page candidate or need for publication/title/page clues
queries.minimum_useful_public_output: status, missing publication/page scope, source limits, and safe next action
queries.expected_evidence_shape: issue, page range, article mention/OCR clue, or explicit article-scan capability gap
known_ambiguities: many 1994 magazines may mention ray tracing
article title and publication are missing
near_miss_rules: broad magazine collection only is near_miss or need
wrong year or topic-adjacent graphics article is near_miss
absence_rules: absence must not claim exhaustive magazine/OCR search
policy_block_rules: public output must not expose OCR, download, crawl, or extraction controls
queries.notes: Unavailable fixture state represents a scoped capability/source gap, not known global absence.
